description: A state update marked as non-urgent with `startTransition`. It can be interrupted and does not replace visible content with Suspense fallbacks.
Returns `[isPending, startTransition]`. `isPending` is `true` until the transition commits, including the whole duration of an async action.
A normal state update, such as typing. React commits it as soon as possible and shows Suspense fallbacks if something suspends.
React's ability (since 18, with `createRoot`) to prepare several versions of the UI and interrupt low-priority work.
React 19: an async function passed to `startTransition`. Updates after `await` need another `startTransition` wrapper.
